## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The command’s adoption path should be fixed because it now emits each adoption message twice.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption records and source-count audit records to settings plans. It adds tests for returned audit records and their exclusion from command output.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Avoid rendering adoption progress twice — For `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)`, the command emits `"Adopted theme"` twice. The planner emits progress immediately, then the new adoption record reaches the unchanged renderer at `app/cli.py:9`. — Users adopting existing settings receive duplicate progress messages, making each adoption appear to occur twice. — Fix: Exclude adoption records from rendering at `app/cli.py:7`, preserving the planner’s progress callback.
